settings.name: Medallion cast vs spin attack
settings.userMessage: Stop spin attacks from cancelling a Bombos/Ether/Quake medallion cast triggered on the same frame.

settings.name: Double indoor-camera nudge
settings.userMessage: Prevent the indoor camera from being nudged twice in one frame (e.g. spin attack between bumpers).

settings.name: Turbo-dash pit levitation
settings.userMessage: Stop turbo-tapping the dash button from letting Link levitate across pits.

settings.name: Walk-on-water near-pit flag
settings.userMessage: Clear the near-pit flag promptly when leaving a hole so Link can't walk on water.

settings.name: Pit-landing exploration glitch
settings.userMessage: Disarm the exploration glitch when landing in a dungeon through an access pit.

settings.name: Cape magic underflow
settings.userMessage: Prevent the magic meter from wrapping to full when the cape drains your last magic.

settings.name: Cape drain while grabbing
settings.userMessage: Make the cape keep draining magic while Link is grabbing or pulling a wall.

settings.name: Somaria empty-magic powder slip
settings.userMessage: Stop an empty-magic Cane of Somaria from auto-sprinkling magic powder if you switch items.

settings.name: Somaria free-magic refund
settings.userMessage: Stop the Cane of Somaria from refunding magic it never spent when slots are full.

settings.name: Magic refund overflow clamp
settings.userMessage: Clamp refunded magic to the meter maximum so it can't overflow.

settings.name: Dash-buffering slope flag
settings.userMessage: Always run slope detection while dashing so the dash-buffering glitch can't trigger.

settings.name: Vertical-slope judder / OOB read
settings.userMessage: Fix jittery diagonal-slope movement and an out-of-bounds read in the vertical slope code.

settings.name: Temp-bunny walk animation
settings.userMessage: Use the correct walk animation for the temporary bunny form.

settings.name: Potion-module door transition guard
settings.userMessage: Skip door-transition handling when a potion has switched Link into another game module.

settings.name: Link_Initialize leftover-state reset (bundles 6 fixes)
settings.userMessage: Reset leftover state on load/continue to close several save-quit, mirror, and bunny-revert glitches.

settings.name: Kiki big-bomb defuse
settings.userMessage: Defuse the big bomb when Kiki the monkey re-grabs you, instead of letting it detonate.

settings.name: Zora shallow-water spawn
settings.userMessage: Let Zoras surface from shallow water (fixes Zoras in Misery Mire that never appear).

settings.name: Mushroom pickup during mirror warp
settings.userMessage: Don't pick up the magic mushroom while a mirror warp is in progress.

settings.name: Giant Moldorm knockback SFX
settings.userMessage: Play the missing hit sound when Giant Moldorm knocks you back.

settings.name: Double heart/fairy absorption
settings.userMessage: Stop hearts and fairies from being processed twice when absorbed (fixes double-absorption).

settings.name: Swamola segment index
settings.userMessage: Fix the Swamola index bug that causes Lanmola glitches in Misery Mire.

settings.name: Mothula L4/spin damage table
settings.userMessage: Let the upgraded sword and spin attack hurt Mothula.

settings.name: Shield palette after Pikit
settings.userMessage: Refresh the shield's colors immediately after a Pikit steals/returns your shield, instead of leaving it the wrong palette.

settings.name: Stale hookshot grab on hidden item
settings.userMessage: Cancel a hookshot's grab on an item once that item becomes hidden under a rock, instead of keeping a stale grab link.

settings.name: Mothula spike-tile damage class
settings.userMessage: Make Mothula take the correct amount of damage from spike-floor tiles (a fix for an altered internal damage class).

settings.name: Giant Moldorm weapon-tink SFX
settings.userMessage: Play the correct 'tink' sound (with panning) when your weapon bounces off the Giant Moldorm, instead of a missing/silent effect.

settings.name: Boomerang stuck on empty-hand release
settings.userMessage: Boomerang ends correctly when released early with nothing in hand, instead of getting stuck.

settings.name: Big-bomb follower-indicator preserve
settings.userMessage: A super bomb explosion no longer wipes your active follower state.

settings.name: Permabunny palette on revive
settings.userMessage: Reviving as a permanent bunny restores the correct bunny colors instead of a glitched palette.

settings.name: Death-counter overcount
settings.userMessage: Don't count a death when you choose 'continue without saving' on the game-over screen.

settings.name: Resume-mosaic sanctuary warp
settings.userMessage: Fix saving/quitting mid-mosaic (e.g. while being electrocuted) wrongly resuming you at the sanctuary.

settings.name: Permabunny death palette
settings.userMessage: Fix Link showing bunny colors during the death animation when dying as a permanent bunny.

settings.name: Room tags during staircase race
settings.userMessage: Prevents items from spawning in the wrong spot when you step onto a staircase at the same moment a room trigger fires.

settings.name: Dungeon update after module exit
settings.userMessage: Fixes a corrupted exit when leaving Skull Woods via a Cane of Somaria door button.

settings.name: Kholdstare shell palette range
settings.userMessage: Fix Kholdstare's frozen shell using the correct palette range during its freeze/melt color fade.

settings.name: Glove color on gear reload
settings.userMessage: Keep the glove color correct (Power/Titan's Glove tint) when Link's gear palettes are reloaded.

settings.name: Super-bomb follower snap-back
settings.userMessage: Super bombs no longer teleport back to you as a follower the moment they detonate.

settings.name: Super-bomb final-frame palette
settings.userMessage: The super bomb keeps its colorful flashing palette on its final frame instead of glitching.

settings.name: Portal music restart
settings.userMessage: Stops the background music from restarting when you step through a portal.

settings.name: Ice Temple portal reveal chime
settings.userMessage: Play the discovery chime when lifting the rock that uncovers the magic portal to the Ice Temple (vanilla is silent here).

settings.name: Widescreen Link hide
settings.userMessage: Hides Link correctly across the full widescreen view (blinking, cape, doorways) instead of only off the normal 4:3 screen.
